definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named ODD-COUNT-BODY statement sequence used to pin the submitted function body.
definitions.text:
rule ODD-COUNT-BODY
    => Assign(Name("result"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
       Assign(Name("s"), Str(""))
       Assign(Name("count"), Int(0))
       Assign(Name("count_string"), Str(""))
       For(Name("s"), Name("lst"), ODD-COUNT-LOOP-BODY)
       Return(Name("result"))
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named ODD-COUNT-LOOP-BODY statement sequence; it is a syntactic abbreviation rather than an execution rule or added fact.
definitions.text:
rule ODD-COUNT-LOOP-BODY
    => Assign(
         Name("count"),
         BinOp(
           "+",
           BinOp(
             "+",
             BinOp(
               "+",
               BinOp(
                 "+",
                 Call(Attribute(Name("s"), "count"), Str("1")),
                 Call(Attribute(Name("s"), "count"), Str("3"))),
               Call(Attribute(Name("s"), "count"), Str("5"))),
             Call(Attribute(Name("s"), "count"), Str("7"))),
           Call(Attribute(Name("s"), "count"), Str("9"))))
       Assign(Name("count_string"), Call(Name("str"), Name("count")))
       Expr(
         Call(
           Attribute(Name("result"), "append"),
           BinOp(
             "+",
             BinOp(
               "+",
               BinOp(
                 "+",
                 BinOp(
                   "+",
                   BinOp(
                     "+",
                     BinOp(
                       "+",
                       BinOp(
                         "+",
                         BinOp(
                           "+",
                           Str("the number of odd elements "),
                           Name("count_string")),
                         Str("n the str")),
                       Name("count_string")),
                     Str("ng ")),
                   Name("count_string")),
                 Str(" of the ")),
               Name("count_string")),
             Str("nput."))))
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Positive constructor equation in the total structural definition of isStringVal.
Owise fallback equation completing the total structural definition of isStringVal.
Simplifying constructor-projection equation defining stringCodes on a str value; it defines the new projection symbol.
Base equation of the structurally recursive allDigitStrings domain predicate.
Cons recurrence defining allDigitStrings by the head string/digit tests and recursive tail predicate.
definitions.text:
rule allDigitStrings(vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq))
    => isStringVal(V)
       andBool allDigit(stringCodes(V))
       andBool allDigitStrings(REST)

definitions.rationale: Equation defining oddDigitCount as the sum of the five single-odd-digit substring counts.
definitions.text:
rule oddDigitCount(CS:IntSeq)
    => cntSub(CS, iCons(49, .IntSeq))
       +Int cntSub(CS, iCons(51, .IntSeq))
       +Int cntSub(CS, iCons(53, .IntSeq))
       +Int cntSub(CS, iCons(55, .IntSeq))
       +Int cntSub(CS, iCons(57, .IntSeq))

definitions.rationale: Equation defining oddLine as the exact nested string concatenation built from oddDigitCount.
definitions.text:
rule oddLine(CS:IntSeq)
    => applyBin(
         "+",
         applyBin(
           "+",
           applyBin(
             "+",
             applyBin(
               "+",
               applyBin(
                 "+",
                 applyBin(
                   "+",
                   applyBin(
                     "+",
                     applyBin(
                       "+",
                       str(strToCodes("the number of odd elements ")),
                       str(strToCodes(Int2String(oddDigitCount(CS))))),
                     str(strToCodes("n the str"))),
                   str(strToCodes(Int2String(oddDigitCount(CS))))),
                 str(strToCodes("ng "))),
               str(strToCodes(Int2String(oddDigitCount(CS))))),
             str(strToCodes(" of the "))),
           str(strToCodes(Int2String(oddDigitCount(CS))))),
         str(strToCodes("nput.")))

definitions.rationale: Base equation of the accumulator-style recursive summary oddLinesAcc.
Cons recurrence defining oddLinesAcc by appending the current oddLine summary and descending on REST.
definitions.text:
rule oddLinesAcc(ACC:ValSeq, vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq))
    => oddLinesAcc(
         valSeqConcat(ACC, vCons(oddLine(stringCodes(V)), .ValSeq)),
         REST)

source_rules.rationale: Additional guarded simplification extending the pre-existing applyMethod symbol from a statically matched str receiver to a Val receiver satisfying isStringVal; Stage 1 does not first prove this exact guarded statement in a module that omits it.
source_rules.text:
rule applyMethod(V:Val, "count", str(PATTERN:IntSeq), .Vals)
    => cntSub(stringCodes(V), PATTERN)
    requires isStringVal(V)
    [simplification]
